## Interfaces

One integration test, tests/test_library_e2e.py::test_library_fixture_close, builds a temporary git repo, initializes the local store from the orchestra contract, writes one signed manifest claim, and creates the acceptance and check-run with adaptive-artifacts create. open_store reads those records back. orchestra close-batch and close_batch.main then both run on that same request. The contract gains the evidence-binding type affidavit.binding.bind_observation writes, matching the affidavit contract, so recheck can see the binding. The CLI close-batch path calls that same close_batch.main.

## Assumptions

Relied on the phase specification, design, work items, and acceptances, plus the diff from c44c532a8bfa997dce5bb7e627f87f01436c0141 to de86e0df31c753d04064576cf7725c5bc3e34880. The file hash of tests/test_library_e2e.py is c46ce427c154f3d5a5b60d8e1ea3795a5bec006366c2c8252b743fd6f469bdcf. Treated the brief's prior-review note as the gap to re-check, not as proof. No execution-report, check-run, assessment, or assignment text was used. Did not re-run pytest. Claim-gate behavior is the one already in orchestra/close_batch.py (acceptance subject falls back to the claim id; human witness uses affidavit library imports). adaptive-artifacts init writes meta.json and resolve writes resolved-contract.json, which this fixture needs for open_store and bind.

## Invariants

Command close and in-process close both take the same repo and request; the command only writes NDJSON and does not apply it, so the Python close still sees the fixture. Both are required to return 0. The Python close spies subprocess.run and fails if argv[0] is aff or adaptive-artifacts. On this fixture the claim gate imports affidavit.verdict.run_verdict and affidavit.binding.recheck; those paths start git and ssh-keygen, not aff or adaptive-artifacts. close_batch.main itself only starts git. The prior exit-code-only assertion is gone: bind failures propagate, open_store checks the created records, and the in-process close must return 0 without those processes.
